scoring_justification: Compute-driven deterministic values; comparing to paper-reported barriers and rate constants with appropriate tolerances is direct and verifiable.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for barriers, heats, and rate constants
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 4 (barriers, heats) and Table 5 for rate constants at 298 K
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted from the paper published values
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported results; the reference solve.sh writes these exact numbers, confirming they are correct targets.

outputs.description: Energy barriers and heats of reaction for the three reaction channels (abstraction, frontside, backside) at the G3MP2//UMP2(full)/6-31G(d,p) level.
CVT/SCT rate constants at 298 K for the three individual channels (k1, k2a, k2b) and the total overall rate constant (k_total).

output_contract.notes: The hidden gold values are the paper-reported barriers, heats, and rate constants. The checker compares submitted values to these with appropriate tolerances (tight for energies, relative for rate constants). No further public details are disclosed.

steps.description: Check barriers and heats of reaction match paper values within tolerance.
Check rate constants at 298 K match within 20% relative tolerance.
